ui.auth-modes-heading: Authentication method (shared by all projects of this OS user that use this URL)
import.conflict.title: A registry with the same URL exists
import.conflict.message:
Choose how to import into "{0}".

Add Scopes: keeps the existing name and scopes.
Replace: uses the name and scopes from the file.
import.failed.title: Import failed
import.failed.read:
Cannot read the file.
Check the file and its access permissions.
import.tooLarge: The settings file is too large.
import.replaceLosesScopes:
Replacing would drop scopes that are registered in or referenced by the project.
Remove them from the project first, or choose Add Scopes.
export.failed.title: Export failed
export.failed.write:
Cannot write the file.
Check the destination and its access permissions.
settings.title: Registry Settings
json.invalid:
The registry settings JSON is invalid.
Check the names, http(s) URLs and scope arrays.
catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.loadError:
Cannot read the catalog.
Check the file.
catalog.cannotSave:
Cannot save the catalog.
Check the file.
catalog.cannotSaveAccess:
Cannot save the catalog.
Check the file and its access permissions.
catalog.conflict: Another Editor updated the catalog, so nothing was saved and the latest content was loaded.
catalog.busy: Another Editor is updating the catalog.
registry.updateFailed.title: Could not update the registry
registry.duplicateName: A registry with the same name already exists.
registry.duplicateUrl: A registry with the same URL already exists.
registry.invalidUrl:
Enter an absolute http(s) URL.
User information, query and fragment are not allowed.
register.failed.title: Could not register the registry
add.title: Add Registry
add.failed.title: Could not register
tip.unresolved:
Cannot be removed because the package source cannot be confirmed.
Check again after Package Manager has resolved.
tip.ambiguous:
Several shared credentials exist for differently written URLs of the same destination, so which one to use cannot be decided.
Delete the one you do not need.
tip.registry.deleteCredential:
Deletes the shared credential for this URL.
Affects all projects of the same OS user.
Tokens are not revoked on the server.
tip.registry.delete:
Deletes the selected registry from the PC-wide catalog, together with the shared credential for this URL.
Affects all projects of the same OS user.
Tokens are not revoked on the server.
tip.row.transient:
A shared credential that is not in the catalog.
Nothing is saved until you enter a name and scopes and press "Add to Catalog".
tip.register.idle: Registers a shared credential that is not in the catalog ({0}) once it is selected and a name and scopes are entered.
tip.register.ready:
Registers the entered name and scopes in the PC-wide catalog.
The shared credential is not changed.
tip.url.transient:
The URL of a credential in the UPM user settings.
It cannot be changed.
tip.setupAuth: Sets up the shared credential for this URL (shared by all projects of the same OS user).
tip.testConnection: Checks the connection to this URL's search API with the same shared credential as Package Manager.
block.draftStale:
This unregistered credential is no longer in the list.
Reopen the page.
block.registryStale:
This registry is no longer in the list.
Reopen the page.
block.inProject: Cannot delete because it is registered in the current project.
block.referenced: Cannot delete because packages reference it.
deleteCredential.failed.title: Could not delete the shared credential
deleteCredential.confirm.title: Delete Shared Credential
deleteCredential.confirm.message:
Deletes the shared credential for this URL, leaving it without authentication.
Affects all projects of the same OS user that use this URL.

Tokens are not revoked on the server.
The catalog and the project manifest are not changed.
deleteRegistry.failed.title: Could not delete the registry
deleteRegistry.confirm.title: Delete Registry
deleteRegistry.confirm.withCredential:
Deletes the registry "{0}" from the PC-wide catalog and also deletes the shared credential for this URL, leaving it without authentication.

Affects all projects of the same OS user that use this URL.
Tokens are not revoked on the server.
The project manifest is not changed.
deleteRegistry.confirm.withoutCredential:
Deletes the registry "{0}" from the PC-wide catalog.
There is no shared credential for this URL.

It is removed from the catalog of all projects of the same OS user.
The project manifest is not changed.
deleteRegistry.credentialKept: The shared credential was not changed.
deleteRegistry.catalogConflict: Another Editor updated the catalog, so nothing was deleted and the latest content was loaded.
deleteRegistry.catalogAfterCredential:
The shared credential was deleted, but the catalog could not be updated.

If the registry remains in the reloaded list, check the file and its access permissions, then delete it again.
deleteRegistry.credentialFailed: The shared credential could not be deleted, so the registry was kept in the catalog.
deleteRegistry.credentialMaybeChanged:
The shared credential may have been changed or deleted.
Check what is shown after reloading.
http.confirm.title: Unencrypted HTTP Connection
http.confirm.check:
Communication with this URL is not encrypted.
If a shared credential is saved, it is also sent in plain text.
http.confirm.save:
Communication with this URL is not encrypted.
The saved credential is sent in plain text by Package Manager.
check.title: Connection Test
check.reachable:
Connected to the registry search API (HTTP {0}).
This does not show that no authentication is required, that packages can be installed, or that every operation is allowed.
check.credentialRequired:
Authentication is required (HTTP 401).
Check the authentication settings.
check.denied:
Access was denied (HTTP 403).
Check the credential's permissions or target.
check.undetermined: Could not determine the connection state.
check.undeterminedStatus: Could not determine the connection state (HTTP {0}).
scope.tip.removeFromProjectFirst: Remove it from the current project first.
scope.tip.delete: Deletes the selected scope from the catalog.
scope.tip.registerFirst: Add it to the catalog first.
scope.tip.remove: Removes this scope from the current project.
scope.tip.add: Adds this scope to the current project.
project.title: Project
project.referenced: Cannot remove from the project because packages reference it.
project.unknown: Cannot remove from the project because the package state is not settled yet.
project.manifestMissingView: The project registration cannot be shown because there is no manifest.
project.manifestUnreadableView: The project registration cannot be changed because the manifest cannot be read.
project.manifestMissing: Nothing was changed because there is no manifest.
project.manifestUnreadable: Nothing was changed because the manifest cannot be read.
project.manifestConflict: Nothing was changed because the manifest was updated at the same time.
project.resolveFailed:
The manifest was updated.
Package Manager failed to resolve again.
project.duplicateUrl: Nothing was changed because several registries have the same URL.
auth.title: Authentication
auth.op.saveToken: Saves the entered token as the shared credential, replacing any existing one.
auth.op.saveBasic:
Saves the entered username and password as npm _auth in the shared credential, replacing any existing one.
Base64 is not encryption.
auth.op.delete:
Deletes the shared credential for this URL, leaving it without authentication.
Tokens are not revoked on the server.
auth.done.saved:
The shared credential was updated.
It applies from the next standard Package Manager operation.
No Editor restart is needed.
auth.done.login:
The OAuth sign-in was saved.
Access rights have not been checked.
It applies from the next standard Package Manager operation.
auth.done.refresh:
The token was refreshed.
It applies from the next standard Package Manager operation.
auth.confirm.title: Change Shared Credential
auth.confirm.shared: Affects all projects of the same OS user that use this URL.
kind.externalConfigured: External setting (not managed by this tool)
error.settings_conflict:
The shared credential was updated by another operation, so nothing was saved.
Reopen the window and check.
error.settings_busy:
Another Editor is updating the shared credential.
Try again later.
error.token_required:
Enter a token.
Saving an empty field does not delete the credential.
error.token_invalid: The token contains characters that cannot be used, or is too long.
error.basic_username:
Enter a username.
Colons and control characters are not allowed.
error.basic_password:
Enter a password.
Control characters are not allowed.
error.registry_url_alias:
A shared credential exists for a differently written URL of the same destination.
Use the existing URL.
error.proxy_https_required: Specify an HTTPS URL for the OAuth proxy.
error.oauth_protocol:
The proxy's OAuth configuration version is not supported.
OAuth was not started.
error.oauth_disabled: OAuth is not enabled on the proxy.
error.oauth_unsupported:
The proxy's OAuth configuration is not supported.
OAuth was not started.
error.callback_port_busy:
The registered callback port is in use.
Close the application using it and try again.
error.callback_bind_failed: Could not start listening for the sign-in result.
error.oauth_consent_denied:
Authorization was denied in the browser.
The credential was not changed.
error.oauth_login_required:
Could not refresh the token.
Sign in again with OAuth.
error.oauth_retry_later: A refresh was just attempted. Try again later.
error.oauth_missing: There is no OAuth credential for this URL.
error.configuration_path_changed: Nothing was updated because the UPM user settings location differs from when it was saved.
error.redirect_rejected: Stopped because the proxy returned a redirect.
error.network_error:
Could not connect.
Check the network and the URL.
error.store:
Cannot read the shared credential store.
Nothing was changed.
error.recovery:
Could not safely complete a previously interrupted save.
The UPM user settings were changed externally.
error.settings_unsafe: The credential file was not used because its access permissions or location are not safe.
error.file:
Could not read or write the file.
Check the access permissions.
error.toml:
The UPM user settings have invalid syntax or a format that cannot be edited safely.
The original file was not changed.
